container: background-color: #ffffff; padding: 48px 18px; letter-spacing: 0.2px; font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'PingFang SC', 'Helvetica Neue', 'Segoe UI', sans-serif
p: font-size: 16px; line-height: 1.7; color: #1d1d1f; margin: 0 0 18px; text-align: left; overflow-wrap: break-word
h2: font-size: 26px; font-weight: 700; color: #1d1d1f; text-align: left; margin: 56px 0 20px; letter-spacing: 0
h2_first: font-size: 26px; font-weight: 700; color: #1d1d1f; text-align: left; margin: 0 0 20px; letter-spacing: 0
h3: font-size: 18px; font-weight: 600; color: #1d1d1f; text-align: left; margin: 32px 0 12px
blockquote: background-color: #f5f5f7; border-radius: 14px; padding: 20px 24px; margin: 0 0 18px; color: #6e6e73; font-size: 15px; line-height: 1.75; text-align: left
code: color: #1d1d1f; font-size: 13px; line-height: 1.6; font-family: Menlo, Consolas, Monaco, 'Courier New', monospace
inline_code: background-color: #f5f5f7; color: #1d1d1f; padding: 2px 6px; border-radius: 5px; font-size: 13px; font-family: Menlo, Consolas, Monaco, 'Courier New', monospace; letter-spacing: 0
list_item: font-size: 16px; line-height: 1.7; color: #1d1d1f; margin: 0 0 12px; text-align: left; overflow-wrap: break-word
th: border-bottom: 1px solid #d2d2d7; padding: 12px 10px; font-weight: 600; color: #6e6e73; font-size: 13px
